snippet.title: Tachyon Fire: Bullet Hell FPS Gameplay Reveal
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4745310/Tachyon_Fire/

Tachyon Fire is a singleplayer arena FPS similar to devil daggers I'm developing in a custom engine. The movement system is similar to Tribes, in that you can ski/slide off of surfaces.
